svg.title: An iterator over a list
svg.desc: The name ranges_m has an arrow to a list object, tag 1, with three slots holding 2.5, 0.9 and 3.1 at indices 0, 1 and 2. The name it has an arrow to a list_iterator object, tag 2, which holds the text next index: 2 and has its own arrow up to the same list. The iterator does not hold a copy of the items.
